# Next.js + Go Boilerplate

Starter monorepo: Go HTTP API (`backend/`) + Next.js BFF (`frontend/`). No tenants or workspaces. Kept modules: auth, global RBAC, platform users/roles, notifications, realtime, queue, MinIO.

## Start here

- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — repo map, shells, request flow
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md — env, local-dev, Dokploy
- docs/EXTENDING.md — how to add a module
- backend/API_CONVENTIONS.md — HTTP envelope and lists
- backend/docs/auth.md — RBAC and JWT
- frontend/README.md — BFF and panels

Canonical env: repo-root `.env`. Login: /platform/login. API: /v1/...
